translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Gálatas
book.title: Kart daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona' gana' mbani Galáciana'

content: Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, shi iṉezile to beena' nakle txen chone' dii mala', ka le' chzenagle c̱he Espíritu c̱he Chioza' chiyaḻ' gaklenlene' kwenc̱he yigooshḻilallee, na' bi gonilene' zi'bia'. Na' ḻi se wṉeyi c̱he kwinle kwenc̱he ki lenle yixople lao dii mala'.
Ḻi gaklen ljwell-le bittezə dii chak c̱hele, ḻa' kan' cheeni Crístona' gonle.
Shi zoa beṉ' chon kwine' beṉ' choo beṉ' xen, chziye'z kwinen'.
To tole chiyaḻ' yiya yiyiljle nak nsa' c̱hele. Na' shi ba chizoile chonle dii wenna', ḻi yiba yizaki, na' bi iṉazle chonchle ka beṉ' yoblə.
Ḻa' to tocho chiyaḻ' sho' yic̱hjcho goncho daa naki c̱hecho.
Beṉ'ka' chzenag cho'a xtill' Chioza' chiyaḻ' we'gake' bi de c̱hegake' beena' chli' chsedi ḻegake'.
Bi gakzile wak siye'le Chioza'. Daa gaz kwekle ḻekzannan' yizi' yilaple.
Beena' choe' cho'a xbayi beli chenna', kwiayee daa chzenague' c̱heyin. San beena' chon ka cheeni Espíritu c̱he Chioza', yizi'e banez yeḻ' mban zejḻi kaṉi daa chzenague' c̱he'.
Bi chiyaḻ' lljx̱akicho goncho dii wenna', ḻa' wllin lla yizi'chon banez kon shi bi yidiṉjicho.
Na' daan, kat' de xḻatjin, chiyaḻ' gonicho wen yog' beṉ', na' llialote beṉ'ka' nakcho toz nonḻilall'cho Crístona'.
Ḻi wwiakachi ka nak letr yeḻ c̱ha'ki.
Beṉ'ka' chonzə byen sho'le seṉ daa le circuncisión, chongake'n kwenc̱hzə kono bi iṉa c̱hegake', na' kono wsak'zi' ḻegake' daa choe'gake' xtill' Crístona', beena' wit ḻee yag cruza'.
Ḻa' ni beṉ'ka' yoo seṉna' bi chizogakile' gongake' doxen ka na leya'. San cheenzgakile' sho'le seṉna' kwenc̱he wshalj wshongake' ba bengake' gan yoolen.

Ka nak nad', biga cheenid' wshalj wshon' c̱he kwin', san wshalj wshon' c̱he daa ben X̱ancho Jesucrístona'. Ḻa' daa wite' ḻee yag cruza' bich bi wṉeyi zia' shi bi iṉa beṉ' c̱ha', na' ka'kzə beṉ' yell-lioka' bich ndegake' nad' kwent.
Bibi zjanayin sho'cho seṉna' wa bi sho'chon, san daa ba bikob Chioza' yic̱hjlall'do'chonan', ḻennan' zakii.
Yiyesh'lall'shgayi Chioza' yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'ka' chon ka ba wnia', na' gone' ka soagake' mbalaz, ḻa' ḻegaken' nakgake' dowalj beṉ' Israel, beṉ'ka' nak yell c̱he'.
Na' ṉaa, bich cheenid' no kwekw nad' dii zed, ḻa' kwerp c̱ha'ni nsa'n yill c̱he yog' diika' ba wxak'zi'a daa chon xshin X̱ancho Jesúza'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, X̱ancho Jesucrístona' soalenshgue' yog'ḻoḻtele na' gaklenshgue' le'. Kan' gakan.

footnotes.text: Kwin' chisyoll chzej' yishi: Páblona' bc̱hine' beṉ' bzeje' dillaa bi'e, per kwine' bzeje' to c̱hop cho'a dill' gana' chiyoll yisha' kwenc̱he gokbe'gakile' ḻen' bseḻeen.
